name: Crop Life Science Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2006, Crop Life Sciences 
Ltd manufactures and deals in pesticides, insecticides, herbicide, fertilizers and allied products related to research and technical formulations[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CLSL is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2004 certified manufacturer of crop protection chemicals, including Insecticides, Fungicides, Herbicides, Weedicides, Micro fertilizers, new generation organic Bio-stimulants, Bio-fertilizers, Bio-Pesticide’s plant growth regulators, and soil plant health products

pros: Stock is trading at 1.05 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 9.66% over last 3 years.
